description: SEC-Navier Stokes structural equivalence and MED regularity analysis

med_regularity_analysis.hypothesis: MED depth <= 2 constrains SEC field complexity, structurally analogous to bounded enstrophy
med_regularity_analysis.1d_evidence: Both SEC and NS enstrophy remain bounded in 1D simulation
med_regularity_analysis.caveat: 1D does not capture critical 3D NS dynamics. This is structural analogy, NOT a proof of NS regularity.

results.conclusion: SEC and NS share identical structural form under the identification v↔∇I, p↔H, ν↔β. MED bounds constrain SEC evolution in ways that parallel enstrophy bounds, but this observation falls short of a regularity proof.
